title: Ephemeral CI/CD "Feature Branch" Testing
goal: Integrate AegisPT micro-scans into developer CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) to test pull requests on feature branches before they are merged.
scope: API endpoint for ephemeral scan launches, CI/CD webhook callbacks, and a CLI/Action wrapper.
generation_reason: Shift security left to developer environments, enabling them to test code at 'Machine Speed'.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Support only URL-based dynamic scanning against deployed ephemeral environments for now, not static code analysis.

success_criteria: New API endpoint allows passing a URL and returning a Pass/Fail status.
A simple GitHub Action template is provided.
Webhook calls back when the mission finishes.

acceptance_criteria: CI API enforces scope limits and successfully triggers a lightweight run profile.

out_of_scope: SAST execution within the CI pipeline
